info.title: Horizon Pulse
info.summary: Pay-per-call APIs over x402 v2; USDC on Solana (selected routes).
info.description: Pay-per-call HTTP APIs over x402 v2, payable in USDC on Solana mainnet (also offered on Base and other rails in the live 402). No signup or API key. Sidecar lists only Solana-payable routes included in this registry entry. Every paid operation carries x-payment-info matching the unpaid 402. Discover: https://horizonpulse.dev/.well-known/x402, https://horizonpulse.dev/openapi.json, https://horizonpulse.dev/llms.txt.
info.x-guidance: Read PAYMENT-REQUIRED (base64 JSON). Pay exact USDC on Base (CDP), Solana (PayAI feePayer), Polygon, or RLUSD on XRPL at the listed payTo. Unpaid samples: /api/demo/{route}. Skill: /skill.md. Hosted MCP: /mcp (Base USDC only).

get.summary: Ranked DeFi yields, pools with TVL of $10M or more (DefiLlama)
get.description:
DeFi yield API: current APY for stablecoin and DeFi pools in one GET, no parameters. Returns JSON: up to 25 pools ordered by a fixed filter tier then APY, each with project, chain, symbol, tvlUsd, apy, apyBase, apyReward, apyMean30d, stablecoin, exposure, ilRisk and poolId. Filters: TVL >= $10M, non-outlier APY. Figures passed through from DefiLlama at fetch time, not advice. Errors are not charged on Base or Polygon (other rails may charge).

Price: $0.02 USDC per call (20000 atomic), paid with x402 v2 `exact` in USDC on Base, Solana or Polygon, or RLUSD on the XRP Ledger (same price). Unpaid requests get 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. No-charge statements above apply to USDC on Base only; on USDC on Solana, and RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, a refused or failed request may still be charged.

Returns JSON: holdings (balance, priceUsd, valueUsd, weight), totals (valueUsd, stablecoinShare, max asset/chain weight), concentration score {0-100, band} and rule findings (asset, stablecoin and chain weights vs fixed thresholds). Read-only; not advice. Invalid addresses return 400, not charged on Base (other rails may charge).

Price: $0.04 USDC per call (40000 atomic), paid with x402 v2 `exact` in USDC on Base, Solana or Polygon, or RLUSD on the XRP Ledger (same price). Unpaid requests get 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. No-charge statements above apply to USDC on Base only; on USDC on Solana, and RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, a refused or failed request may still be charged.

Returns JSON: httpStatus, isX402, x402Version, decoded accepts (network, asset, USD amount, payTo, EOA or contract), discovery metadata presence, and pass/warn/fail checks. get.summary: Turn recipe ingredient lines into a normalized shopping list
get.description:
Recipe ingredient parser and shopping list API: POST JSON {ingredients: [lines], servings?, targetServings?} (or GET ingredients=line|line). Returns per line name, canonicalId, qty, unit, metric (ml or g), category, optional/toTaste, prepNote, stated pack size, a typical pack hint, plus a merged shoppingList scaled to targetServings and unparsed lines. Deterministic, no outbound calls, no prices, nothing stored. Bad input (400) or nothing parsed (422) (Base: not charged; other rails may charge).

Price: $0.002 USDC per call (2000 atomic), paid with x402 v2 `exact` in USDC on Base, Solana or Polygon, or RLUSD on the XRP Ledger (same price). parameters.description: Ingredient lines separated by | (max 100 lines, 200 chars each). POST JSON is preferred.
parameters.example: 2 cups all-purpose flour|3 large eggs|1 tbsp olive oil

parameters.name: servings
parameters.description: Servings the recipe makes, integer 1-100 as digits. Give with targetServings to scale, or neither.

parameters.description: Servings wanted, integer 1-100 as digits.

200.description: Paid success. The settlement receipt is in the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header.

methodology.parser: Deterministic rule-based parser (quantities incl. fractions, unicode fractions and ranges; unit aliases; parenthetical pack sizes; prep notes after a comma). No network, no third-party data, no AI model.
methodology.units: Volume converts to ml and mass to g with exact factors (US customary: tsp 4.92892 ml, tbsp 14.7868 ml, cup 236.588 ml, fl oz 29.5735 ml, pint 473.176 ml, quart 946.353 ml, gallon 3785.41 ml; oz 28.3495 g, lb 453.592 g). Volume is never converted to mass (no density guesses). Count units stay counts.
methodology.packs: packHint is from a small Horizon Pulse table of typical US pack sizes, for planning only. It is not a retailer listing, not stock and not a price.
methodology.scaling: If servings and targetServings are both given, every quantity is multiplied by targetServings / servings.

caveats: Not a poll: self-selected posters on two tech-leaning, US-heavy networks; not representative of any population.
Keyword search misses posts that use other words and can include off-topic posts.
Bots, coordinated posting and brigading can move the numbers; one-vote-per-account and per-thread caps only reduce this.
